verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents its own agent coding workflows: Oneshot for small changes, RPI with registered sub-agents, and PRD-Oriented. These run Claude Code or Codex sessions that implement work, and the session agent can open a draft PR, which covers feature implementation through to a PR. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent writing or running tests. Missing for 10: any documented test-writing or test-running step, hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery, and detail on what the implement phase produces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: A clear and small change can use Oneshot.
HumanLayer registers these RPI sub-agents for Claude Code sessions
Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment
